===''Pokémon the Series''=== [[File:Juniper anime.png|thumb|220px|Professor Juniper in {{aniseries|BW}}]] In the {{pkmn|animated series}}, Professor Juniper debuted in ''[[BW001|In The Shadow of Zekrom!]]'' as an old friend of {{an|Professor Oak}}. She gave {{Ash}}, {{Delia}}, and Oak a ride in her SUV to her lab so she could study [[Ash's Pikachu]] who was ill. Later, she showed Ash the Unova [[first partner Pokémon]], then gave [[Trip]] his first {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}, {{TP|Trip|Snivy}}. Ash later returned to Professor Juniper's lab after finding out that Pikachu had lost his electricity from {{p|Zekrom}}. Later the storm arrived again but this time it gave Pikachu's electric powers back, and Ash departed from her lab the next day. In ''[[BW003|A Sandile Gusher of Change!]]'', Juniper sent Ash the Poké Ball belonging to the {{AP|Oshawott}} that was supposed to go to a new Trainer, but wandered away to go with Ash. In ''[[BW013|Minccino-Neat and Tidy!]]'' it was shown that she had sent {{an|Bianca}} to give Ash his Badge case. She then spoke to Ash via Bianca's [[Xtransceiver]]. Ash sent his {{AP|Pidove}} to her in ''[[BW018|Sewaddle and Burgh in Pinwheel Forest!]]'', in order to make room for his newly captured {{AP|Sewaddle}}. He switched them in ''[[BW021|The Lost World of Gothitelle!]]''. In ''[[BW022|A Venipede Stampede!]]'', Professor Juniper and her lab assistants monitored {{p|Venipede}} swarm event in [[Castelia City]], and they quickly identified that the problem was linked with strong energy waves coming from the [[Desert Resort]]. She flew over to Castelia and met up with Ash and {{ashfr}} to investigate the unusual activity caused by [[Team Rocket]]. She was also set to appear in the [[Banned episodes|unaired]] and non-[[canon]]ical [[BW023 (unaired)|final]] [[BW024 (unaired)|episodes]] of Team Rocket's [[Meteonite]] mission; in May 2023, the scripts for these episodes surfaced,https://bulbagarden.net/threads/bw023-bw024-unaired-scripts-found.297127/ revealing that Juniper was to be involved in investigating the history of the [[Relic Castle]] and would recover a small Meteonite stolen by Team Rocket from the [[Nacrene City]] museum so it could be returned to [[Lenora]]. In ''[[BW036|Archeops In The Modern World!]]'', [[Fennel]] helped Juniper revive an {{p|Archen}} from a [[Plume Fossil]]. Archen later evolved into {{p|Archeops}} and left with a passing flock of Archeops. While the encounter was brief, Juniper was able to document the [[cry]] and behavioral data on the Archen evolutionary line. In ''[[BW062|Crisis at Chargestone Cave!]]'', the group encountered Professor Juniper while she and her team were conducting research on the electric stones of [[Chargestone Cave]]. Juniper also met up with Bianca for their planned [[trade]] in ''[[BW063|Evolution Exchange Excitement!]]''. Juniper traded her {{p|Karrablast}} for Bianca's {{p|Shelmet}}, making both of them evolve at [[Chargestone Cave]]. In order to help Bianca work with her new {{p|Escavalier}}, Professor Juniper suggested they have a [[Multi Battle|Tag Battle]] against Ash and Cilan, who used {{AP|Boldore}} and {{TP|Cilan|Crustle}}, respectively. Although Professor Juniper's {{p|Accelgor}} and Bianca's Escavalier learned to work together and eventually defeat Boldore, they were both defeated by Crustle's {{m|Rock Wrecker}}. Juniper was surprised to encounter her father [[Cedric Juniper|Cedric]], who revealed that he had located the [[Hero's Ruin]]. Ash's group left with Cedric in ''[[BW064|Explorers of the Hero's Ruin!]]'', while Professor Juniper remained behind to continue her Chargestone Cave research. In ''[[BW109|New Places... Familiar Faces!]]'', Juniper met up with Ash and his friends again when they returned to Nuvema Town after the [[Vertress Conference]]. She also presented a beginner Trainer, [[Nanette]], the three first partner Pokémon. After some thinking, Nanette chose {{p|Tepig}} as her first Pokémon. Juniper also received a call from her father, who revealed that the {{an|White Ruins}} had been discovered. While Juniper was unable to join her father, she suggested Ash's group visit the new [[Aspertia Gym]] en route to the White Ruins. In ''[[BW123|Farewell, Unova! Setting Sail for New Adventures!]]'', Juniper told Ash and {{ashfr}} about a cruise that would travel through the [[Decolore Islands]] to [[Kanto]], after they expressed their wishes to travel to Kanto together. She bought tickets for them to board the ship, but a disguised [[James]] bumped into her on purpose to switch the tickets around with fakes to lure Ash and his friends into another scheme of {{TRT}}'s. She wished the group all the best before returning to her lab. She also made plans to transfer Ash's Unova Pokémon from her lab to [[Professor Oak's laboratory]]. Juniper made a cameo appearance in the ending credits of ''[[M16|Genesect and the Legend Awakened]]''. ====Character==== Professor Juniper is pleasant and mature. She willingly offers her assistance, even providing {{ashfr|Ash's group}} with ship tickets on two occasions, in ''[[BW109|New Places... Familiar Faces!]]'' and ''[[BW123|Farewell, Unova! Setting Sail for New Adventures!]]'', respectively. She has a particular interest in the origins of Pokémon.
